Definition: Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Mizpeh = "watchtower"; 1) a city in the district of the Shephelah or lowlands of Judah; 2) a place in Moab on the east of the Jordan; 3) a place in Gilead; 4) a place near Mount Hermon; 5) a place in Benjamin; also 'Mizpah'
